study: Bounded nonlinear readout transfer of strictly internal Raw-conditional feature selection
rationale: The legal internal conditional ridge contrast was positive but selection-conditioned and unstable. Test transfer to nonlinear readouts without using the assessment labels to select cardinality in this new procedure. This is an intermediate experiment, not a replacement for full M8 or a new Outer validation.
cohort_and_source: Exact original80patients/7635channels/256seizures, existing32-group pool and15 assessment paths (screens1to3 in five original folds). Same20 frozen strictly inner-cross-fitted encoders; only the15 assessment-path encoders are used. No raw retraining or new extraction. Original Development and Outer excluded.
selection: For each assessment path separately, use its preexisting canonical ridge greedy choice-utility path k0to9. Choose smallest k within0.005 of the maximum choice utility. Do not use that fold's previously selected global k or any assessment metric. Existing path choices already used this feature-choice set; this is an exploratory transfer study, not fresh independent confirmation.
input: 192 frozen patient-relative Raw coordinates (both0to20/0to30 supports), plus fixed64 physiological mean/SD slots. Refit imputation/standardization on selection-training plus feature-choice only, no new scaling floor/clipping/feature rejection. Mask unused physiology after preprocessing. All arms have the same256 slots and trainable width.
head: Linear256to64, GELU, Linear64to1 NEZ logit,16513 parameters, no dropout. Same architecture as the registered Concat readout except the explicitly doubled Raw support. Not called full Concat/M8 because CNN is frozen and dual support differs.
optimization: Exact original P3 M8_MACRO_AWARE objective (0.75 weighted NEZ BCE plus0.25 patient softMacroF1), patient-equal full-channel updates, original global class weighting, AdamW lr0.0003 wd0.001 clip1 max30 min6 patience6. Same patient ordering and initialization across arms; fit only selection-training plus feature-choice. Calibration alone selects epoch by MacroF1/EZF1/earliest and the original EZ probability0to1 step0.005 threshold/ties.
seed_scope: Two readout initializations only. Raw encoders remain their original seed42 training. No best-seed choice or probability ensemble. Report both seeds and fixed equal-seed averages of paired patient metrics.
budget: At most90 logical small readouts (15paths x3arms x2seeds), fewer actual fits for identical masks. At most2700 readout epochs. Zero new full Raw encoder or M8 training in this registration.
evaluation: Freeze all selected masks, roles, preprocessing and plan before any readout fit. Complete all model/epoch/threshold choices, save per-cell assessment logits and seal all outputs before assessment label metrics. Do not use original Development/Outer artifacts or tune after results. Patientmacro9 endpoints;15path/fivefold/source and head-seed stability;10000 paired patient-ID cluster draws carrying all repeated appearances and both seeds together.
estimand: Primary equals fixed equal-head-seed averages of patient metrics, then means over the255 patient-fold assessment appearances (79 unique identities). Paired resampling clusters by identity and retains all appearances together. Always also publish unique-identity-equal averages as secondary, not choose between estimands after outcomes.
primary_gate: Before any later model-family-matched full training: fixed two-seed-average four-endpoint utility (AUROC/AP/MacroF1/EZF1) delta versus RAW_ONLY must have unadjusted95percent patient-ID cluster interval lower>0; every four-endpoint mean delta must be>0 in EACH readout seed, and every known-source AUROC delta must be>=-0.02. This is a prospective engineering/research allocation rule, not a confirmatory significance claim. Report all endpoints regardless of gate.
stop: If gate fails, do not automatically add head variants, seeds, hyperparameters, feature maps or new Outer. If it passes, any full M8/Raw training needs a separately fixed prospective protocol; this registration never automatically launches it. Stable global feature minimality remains a separate unproven requirement.
mechanistic_audit: Map all32 feature names by source definitions to measurement attributes and coarse physiological families; compare exact/attribute/family selection overlap in existing public selections. This is post hoc descriptive sensitivity, not a new selector or evidence of exact equivalence. Never merge actual inputs or claim all broad-family members interchangeable.
fidelity: Keep every previous protocol, scientific source, model, threshold, prediction seal, failed numerical result and released artifact unchanged. Exact checkpoint resume with new logs after diagnosed engineering failure only. CPU FP32, existing stable environment, process-local one-thread settings/affinity16; no unrelated GPU or runtime changes.
privacy: Only code, anonymous aggregate plans/audits/results/report/figures published. Individual labels, identities, logits, embeddings, models, scalers and logs remain private. Goal success is not assumed by computational completion.
